scope: Provisional convenience watchdog; outside the seal and selection hash chain per 0642.

expected_behavior_controls.explanation: Ten failing expected-behavior controls demonstrate five distinct convenience defects; this is not a 25/25 PASS.

findings.claim: A value-taking option at the end of argv hangs in the argument loop.
findings.evidence: TESTED: each of --log, --threshold-gib, --interval-s, --max-polls and --df-stub timed out in the exact leading source slice; subprocess.run killed each owned test child after 0.4 seconds. Failed shift 2 leaves argv unchanged.
findings.fix: Check argument count before shift and refuse missing values with exit 2.

findings.claim: Lexical log restrictions can be bypassed through a symlinked parent directory.
findings.evidence: TESTED: a direct owned inert runs_ext fixture path refused, but an innocent-named symlink to that same owned fixture allowed log creation. No real excluded tree was accessed. Existing file and final-component symlink controls preserved prior bytes.
findings.fix: Use a verified no-follow parent traversal and exclusive descriptor-based log creation; retain the verified descriptor for writes, or use the existing reviewed path helper contract.

findings.claim: Digit-only validation permits invalid octal and overflowing threshold arithmetic.
findings.evidence: TESTED: exact arithmetic accepts ordinary 80-GiB boundary controls, but 080 causes an arithmetic error; 8796093022208 wraps when multiplied by 1048576 and suppresses the expected low-space decision. STATIC ONLY: interval zero is accepted and would remove the intended poll delay.
findings.fix: Normalize bounded decimal values, require positive interval and threshold, and bound the multiplication before use. Retain max-polls zero only as the documented unlimited sentinel.

findings.claim: The notification self-test exits successfully after the notification command fails.
findings.evidence: TESTED with exact function and test-notify branch: an owned shell-function osascript double returned 7; the log recorded rc=7, but the branch exited 0. The matching rc=0 control passed. No real AppleScript or notification ran.
findings.fix: Return the notifier status after logging and propagate it from test-notify; continuous operation may log and continue with explicit degraded status.

findings.claim: The author test exits successfully when its accumulated status is failure.
findings.evidence: TESTED using only the exact final status slice: ok_all=0 printed SOME FAIL but exited 0 after the final echo. The ok_all=1 positive passed. The author test itself was never run.
findings.fix: Exit nonzero after printing the output path whenever ok_all is not 1.

tested: Exact bounded source slices with owned inert fixtures only.
All evidence byte hashes checked; current author source hashes still equal snapshots.
untested: Full watchdog execution, persistent background operation, real df behavior and real notification/sound.
Production paths, scientific work, seal execution or new selected tuple.
scope_limits: No original watchdog or author test script executed.
No notification, scientific launch, real protected run, observed velocity, network, git write or session-log read.
No existing file overwritten, moved or deleted. Timeout termination affected only owned synthetic test children.
The default 80 GiB is explicitly documented and earlier than an 80-decimal-GB alert; no seal blocker is inferred from that choice.
Previously reported v003/pre-stage review conclusions are unchanged.
